rationale.conceptual: The method (DFT with PBE functional, geometry optimization) is a standard toolbox in computational chemistry. No novel theory or custom algorithms are required; the paper applies an established technique to a specific cluster system. Understanding the physics (sp3 hybridisation, passivation) is modestly non-trivial but well within the domain of a typical DFT user.
rationale.execution: The reproduction involves a multi‑stage pipeline: constructing initial Ih‑symmetric structures, running two separate DFT relaxations with convergence thresholds, extracting bond lengths/gaps/charges, computing isolated‑atom energies, and assembling the results JSON. Although each step is routine, orchestration of DFT codes (Quantum ESPRESSO/CP2K), monitoring convergence, and post‑processing adds moderate engineering complexity.
